fullContentHtml:
BSUSC Bihar Assistant Professor Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar State University Service Commission (BSUSC) has released the notification for the post of Assistant Professor Post. This recruitment has been issued for 3687 posts. Online applying process for BSUSC Bihar Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 has started from 03 July 2026 & the candidates can apply till 15 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for BSUSC Bihar Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 July 2026
  • Last Date : 15 July 2026
  • Interview Dates : 20-27 July 2026
  • Merit List : 29 July 2026
  • Colleges Preference  : 30 July 2026
  • Final Allotment : 01 August 2026
  • Joining Last Date: 07 August 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates No Application Fess

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Important Links

  • Apply OnlineApply Online
  • Official WebsiteOfficial Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is BSUSC Bihar Assistant Professor Online Form 2026?

BSUSC Bihar Assistant Professor Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 15 July 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://bsusc.bihar.gov.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
